query:
SELECT
            k.id     AS "id!",
            k.name   AS "name!",
            COUNT(*) AS "requests!"
        FROM relay_invocations i
        JOIN api_keys k ON k.id = i.api_key_id
        WHERE k.user_id = $1
          AND i.created_at >= $2
          AND i.created_at <  $3
        GROUP BY k.id, k.name
        ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
        LIMIT 20
